acquisition_method.evidence: LC-MS/MS DIA on the Fusion Lumos was initiated by trapping the peptide material at 20 μl/min for 2 min in loading solvent A on a Pepmap column (300 μm internal diameter (I.D.), 5 μm beads, C18, Thermo Fisher Scientific).

alkylation_concentration.evidence: In brief, proteins in lysis buffer (5% SDS, 50 mM TEAB, pH 7.4) were reduced and alkylated using 5 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (10 min at 55 °C) and 20 mM iodoacetamide (10 min at room temperature in the dark), respectively.

cleavage_agent.evidence: For protein digestion, 0.5 μg of trypsin (Promega, V5111) was added to 125 μl 50 mM TEAB (pH 7.4), and samples were incubated overnight at 37 °C.
